source_text:
3.11
Ἀφρικανοῦ· περὶ δυσουρίασ Ἐὰν ἵππου τὰ οὖρα ἐπισχεθῇ, παρθένος λύσασα ἣν φορεῖ
ζώνην, τυψάτω αὐτὸν κατὰ τοῦ προσώπου τῇ ζώνῃ, καὶ παραχρῆμα ἐξουρήσει
ἀθρόως καὶ ἡ ὀδύνη παύσεται.
pass_a_gloss: 3.11 Of-Africanus: about dysuria. If of-a-horse the urines have-been-held, a-virgin having-loosed which she-wears girdle, let-her-strike him according-to the face with-the-girdle, and immediately he-will-urine in-a-mass and the pain will-cease.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: about dysuria. If a horse's urine has been held, let a virgin, having loosed the girdle she wears, strike him on the face with the girdle, and immediately he will urine in a mass and the pain will cease.

choices.term: τυψάτω αὐτὸν κατὰ τοῦ προσώπου τῇ ζώνῃ
choices.english: strike him on the face with the girdle
choices.why: κατὰ τοῦ προσώπου is the face of the horse, not a blow 'according to appearance'.
rejected: strike him according to the person
beat the face of the girdle

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
